verdict.rationale: Riveter is a SaaS data-enrichment API, so choosing a data storage region or residency is a fair question for it. The evidence pack has nothing on regions, residency, or storage location. The local MCP option (riveter-docs-10) only changes where the connector runs, not where data is stored, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
